promises.text: A vault lies under a ruined works. The people who found what had grown in it sealed it. They nailed the door shut.

confirmed.note: The ruin court of the works stands over the vault; the vault face is dug out under the berm, and the door is boarded.

promises.text: The voriplasm lives in the vault. It has been sealed in the vault for two hundred years.

confirmed.note: No placed thing: the creature is inside the vault interior; outside, only the bones at the door say something lives there.

promises.text: The note of the sealing party is still nailed to the door. The note names the contents of the vault.

promises.text: The vault is a stone undercroft with one door and no other opening.

confirmed.note: The vault face is one closed stone wall with the single doorhole and its load door; the claimed interior is reached only through it.

promises.text: If the vault were opened, a creature would be released. The province has a specific and unhappy history with that creature.

confirmed.note: A history line, no placed thing: kept by the sealed door and the board's warning.
